mesh.name: mesh
mesh.flattened_by: team mesh (dry run only; not flattened by us)

rows_rule: explicit 'row' field if present, else new row when centre gap > 0.6 x median h_px; baseline at bottom+2 moved into the inter-row gap when a letter covers it, never clamped into the map
heldout_text:
# Held-out validation (dry run on the control scroll PHerc0139 / w040; NOT a submission)
Gate A (RULES G-A), 2026-09-17: w040 native 9.362 um stack through the fixed call (seed42 step-075000, plain): forward AUC 0.99659, reverse 0.49633 on 1,629,734 supervised pixels; mean on ink 0.758, on blank 0.252.
Gate B (RULES G-B): rebuilt vc_render_tifxyz vs the team stack on the 2048x2048 crop: Pearson >= 0.999999 on all 28 slices; through the model: plain 0.99680 / 0.50265, TTA 0.99024 / 0.56576.
Gate C and the w028 judge: pending (queued).
method_text:
# Method (dry run)
Renderer: vc_render_tifxyz (villa 5ab585f) 28 slices, step 1, --flip-normals on team meshes. Model: scrollprize/ink_9um hybrid_3d2d-seed42/step-075000.pth via `python -m vesuvius.ink_detection.inference.infer <stack.zarr> <ckpt> <out.tif> --direction both --batch-size 4 --no-compile --num-workers 3` (patch 128, stride 64, Hann blend, robust_mad 1-99 %). Both depth orders always read. Rule 5.5 screen. See METHOD.md in the repository.
